netflix.title: Slachtvee
netflix.overview: Thomas, in his forties, holds an important post in a slaughterhouse. He is engaged to Marie-Rose, the daughter of the director, whom he hopes to follow later. In a routine examination in the hospital, however, he finds out that he has cancer and his days are counted. The upheaval that he suffers as a result, however, does not take long, his decision is certain: he will use the short time to clean up some bad guys. What else can he do now?

amazon-prime-video.title: Love of Your Life
amazon-prime-video.overview: After a chance encounter sparks a sweeping romance, Maya's future is suddenly upended, sending her on an unexpected journey to love and live again.

amazon-prime-video.title: I Would Rather Die
amazon-prime-video.overview: The protagonist Archie, considered the school loser, is bitten by a zombie and finds himself at the center of a mission to save the city alongside his friends Cris and Brenda.

amazon-prime-video.title: Neagley
amazon-prime-video.overview: Neagley, drawing from her experience with Jack Reacher and the 110 Special Investigators, embarks on a perilous mission to expose a sinister threat, risking her life to unravel the mystery.

apple-tv.title: Matchbox the Movie
apple-tv.overview: When a group of former childhood friends reconnect, their reunion takes a wild turn as they stumble upon a dangerous international plot—and must save the world.

apple-tv.title: The Last First: Winter K2
apple-tv.overview: K2's first winter ascent claimed 5 lives, revealing modern alpinism's struggles with commercialization, social media impact, and conflicts between marginalized climbers and traditional elites.

apple-tv.title: Brothers
apple-tv.overview: Matthew and Woody have been best friends for years, but a shocking family secret suggests their connection might be closer.

disney-plus.title: Coven Academy
disney-plus.overview: In the haunted heart of New Orleans, three teenage witches and their warlock peers attend an elite magic boarding school where power is currency, secrets are lethal and attraction is a liability.

wow-presents-plus.title: Goodbye Goodbye Goodbye
wow-presents-plus.overview: After we watch a queen sashay away each week, Kyran Thrax gives them a call to say hello — and goodbye, goodbye, goodbye. The RuPaul’s Drag Race UK winner gets the first post-elimination debrief, digging into fan reactions and burning questions fans want answered.

hayu.title: Still Flipping Out
hayu.overview: Follows Lewis as he navigates the hilariously unpredictable nature of his professional and personal lives as his trademark spontaneity collides with the people who work with him, for him, and still somehow survive him.

mubi.title: JAŸ-Z in 8
mubi.overview: Thirty years after his landmark debut album, artist, icon, philanthropist, and entrepreneur JAŸ-Z sits down with longtime friend, producer, and director Rick Rubin for an intimate reflection on his storied career.

mubi.title: Pulp: What Do You Do for an Encore?
mubi.overview: A fusion of the brilliantly choreographed stage spectacle of Pulp’s biggest ever arena show — part of the global tour for More, the band’s first album in 24 years — with four decades of colorful, never-seen-before archival material.

bloodstream.title: Last Chance Motel
bloodstream.overview: A newlywed couple's dream wedding spirals into a bloody nightmare when they uncover that their secluded venue- a desolate motel deep in the Nevada desert- is run by a relentless bloodthirsty family with dark secrets, revealing that one bride's future may not be all that it was promised to be.

bloodstream.title: Witchcraft Motion Picture Company Presents: Science Fiction Anthology Volume 1
bloodstream.overview: Witchcraft Motion Picture Company and Rod Blackhurst present their first anthology collection of science fiction short films.

crunchyroll-amazon-channel.title: Full Clearing Another World under a Goddess with Zero Believers
crunchyroll-amazon-channel.overview: An isekai fantasy where an ordinary gamer reincarnates without special powers, teams up with a minor goddess, and rises from the weakest to the strongest in a new world.

crunchyroll-amazon-channel.title: From Far Away
crunchyroll-amazon-channel.overview: Noriko is an ordinary high school student, until an explosion pulls her into a world of magic where no one speaks her language. Completely lost, Noriko is rescued by Izark, a shunned swordsman determined to kill the Awakening: a prophesied figure said to control the Sky Demon. As Izark and Noriko bond, he realizes she may be the very person he’s hunting.
